hypothesis.statement: Driving inverseDynamics2D (Newton-Euler, de Leva inertia) with real WBDS markers + GRF recovers the sagittal ankle/knee/hip moments, validated against the dataset's own moments (knt) with the textbook distal-to-proximal accuracy gradient: ankle r~0.97 (physiological push-off peak), knee r~0.85, hip r~0.77 (5 subjects).

analysis_plan.dataset: WBDS (figshare 5722711), 5 subjects (WBDS01-05), self-selected-speed treadmill walking; inputs = right-limb sagittal joint-centre markers + right-belt GRF, reference = the dataset's own knt joint moments

decision.threshold: descriptive: per-joint correlation of the recovered sagittal moment with the WBDS reference; the ankle (nearest the measured GRF) should recover excellently (r>0.95) and the accuracy should degrade proximally (ankle > knee > hip)
